args: set -euo pipefail; export DOCKER_CONFIG=/tmp/.docker HOME=/tmp; SELENIUM_NAME="selenium_${DAG_RUN_ID:-$$}_$(date +%s)"; cleanup() { docker rm -f "$SELENIUM_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; docker run -d --rm --name "$SELENIUM_NAME" --shm-size=2g -e SE_NODE_MAX_SESSIONS=1 -e SE_NODE_OVERRIDE_MAX_SESSIONS=true selenium/standalone-chrome:latest >/dev/null; docker exec "$SELENIUM_NAME" bash -lc "for i in \$(seq 1 60); do (echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/4444) >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1"; docker run --rm --network container:"$SELENIUM_NAME" -v /home/ubuntu/work/fisgon:/app -v /home/ubuntu/data_storage:/home/ubuntu/data_storage -w /app -e OPERATION=0 -e DOCKER_CONFIG=/tmp/.docker -e HOME=/tmp -e TARGET_CITY -e TARGET_SCRAPER -e DAG_RUN_URL="${DAGU_BASE_URL}/dags/${DAG_NAME}?dagRunId=${DAG_RUN_ID}" -e DAG_RUN_LOG_URL="${DAGU_BASE_URL}/dags/${DAG_NAME}/log?remoteNode=local&step=tarea_1&dagRunId=${DAG_RUN_ID}" fisgon_scraper:1.0
